'''Vregg''' was a dialect of [[Gamorrese]]. [[Wioslea/Legends|Wioslea]] was able to speak Vregg, as was the [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Gorc]].<ref name="Dark Forces">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050609a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 5: Two Peas in a Pod}}</ref>
